あらすじ

Hayato Kijou lost his home and all his belongings in a landslide. Clueless about what to do he called a woman who he never expected to see again. Shouko Yuzuhara is the Ex-Wife of his older brother and the only person he could rely on. She let him stay at her apartment and they slowly get closer…

  • スコア: 5.01/10 (42 人評価)
  • 日本語名: Apprehend;Girlfriend
  • 英語名: 无

あらすじ

Rikka lives in a Share House in Tokyo, making a living by working as a freelance artist.

Since the third tenant moved out recently, it’s a good opportunity for her to get closer to her House Mate Sena.

They just started as normal friends, but with the time passing, they get closer and closer.

Soon there was no doubt left, that Rikka and Sena felt more for each other than friendship.

あらすじ

The protagonist is a gamer who dropped out of college to have more time to play video games. He used all his savings to buy an exclusive gaming console, called Sirrah. He has a lot of fun with the console even if he has nothing else left. One day, he wakes up and sees a strange but cute girl in his room. It turns out that the girl is his beloved console Sirrah! What will happen to them?!

Perfect opportunity to celebrate his 10 year wedding anniversary with his wife Kotoko. Together with their daughter Hotaru, they are traveling to a tropical island in the south and have a very nice time in a beautiful paradise. But on one night a meteor shower appeared and everything changed…
